RINGMAKER.settings.image.name: Ring image
RINGMAKER.settings.image.hint: A square PNG with a transparent middle (256 × 256 or larger). Used by every token with Foundry's dynamic ring turned on. Leave empty to leave Foundry's own ring alone. Reloads Foundry.
RINGMAKER.settings.targets.name: Which tokens
RINGMAKER.settings.targets.hint: Which tokens Ringmaker turns the ring on for. NPCs are actors that aren't of the "character" type and that no player owns.
RINGMAKER.settings.newTokens.name: Ring new tokens
RINGMAKER.settings.newTokens.hint: Tokens placed from now on get the ring as they're created.
RINGMAKER.settings.ringSize.name: Ring size
RINGMAKER.settings.ringSize.hint: How big the ring is, as a percentage of Foundry's own ring (100 = the same size as core rings). Ringmaker finds the ring band in your image and scales it to this size; the background and the token art follow. Reloads Foundry.
RINGMAKER.settings.background.name: Background colour
RINGMAKER.settings.background.hint: The colour behind the token art, inside the ring. A token's own ring background colour (Token configuration) is used instead when it has one. Reloads Foundry.
RINGMAKER.settings.ringInFront.name: Ring in front of token art
RINGMAKER.settings.ringInFront.hint: Draw the ring over the token art and trim the art to the ring's opening. Turn off for Foundry's own order (art over the ring, so cut-out art can reach past it). Reloads Foundry.
RINGMAKER.settings.artScale.name: Token art size inside the ring
RINGMAKER.settings.artScale.hint: Foundry's ring subject scale, set on the tokens Ringmaker rings. 1 (Foundry's default) keeps the ring at its normal size; below 1 the ring grows around the art, above 1 it shrinks. A scale you set on a token yourself is kept.
RINGMAKER.settings.artZoom.name: Per-token art zoom
RINGMAKER.settings.artZoom.hint: Lets each token's art be zoomed in or out inside the ring (Token configuration › Dynamic Token Ring › Art zoom, and the Fit art button). The zoom is kept in flags.ringmaker.artZoom; with this off every token uses Foundry's framing and the stored zooms are ignored. Reloads Foundry.
RINGMAKER.settings.targetEffect.name: Ring effect on targeted tokens
RINGMAKER.settings.targetEffect.hint: While a token with the ring is targeted, use one of Foundry's own ring effects on it: Pulse or Gradient while it stays targeted, or a single Flash in the targeting player's colour. Drawn on each client only; nothing is saved. Off by default. Reloads Foundry.
RINGMAKER.settings.debugLog.name: Debug logging
RINGMAKER.settings.debugLog.hint: Write what Ringmaker is doing to the browser console (ring registration, apply and remove counts). Errors are always logged. Wanderer's Satchel can switch this for all your modules.
RINGMAKER.settings.existingOnLoad.name: Ring existing tokens on load
RINGMAKER.settings.existingOnLoad.hint: Each time the world loads, the active GM puts the ring on any token (and actor prototype token) that should have it and doesn't yet.
RINGMAKER.targetEffects.flash: Flash once (in the targeting player's colour)
RINGMAKER.menu.name: Ringmaker tools
RINGMAKER.menu.label: Open Ringmaker
RINGMAKER.menu.hint: Apply the ring to tokens already in the world, or remove Ringmaker's ring.
RINGMAKER.window.title: Ringmaker
RINGMAKER.window.heading: Ringmaker tools
RINGMAKER.window.gmOnly: Only a GM can change these settings or tokens.
RINGMAKER.window.noImage.title: No ring image chosen.
RINGMAKER.window.noImage.text: Pick one in the module settings (Ring image). Until then Ringmaker leaves Foundry's ring alone.
RINGMAKER.window.notActive: Not the active ring style yet: reload Foundry.
RINGMAKER.window.band: Ring band found at {inner}–{outer}% of the image's radius.
RINGMAKER.window.look.head: Ring look (preview)
RINGMAKER.window.look.preview: Preview of the ring over a sample token picture
RINGMAKER.window.look.front: Ring in front of token art
RINGMAKER.window.look.hint: A close guide, not the exact drawing: sizes use the same layout maths as the ring texture, but a token's own background colour, ring effects and the shader's edge blending aren't shown. Saving changes the world settings and reloads Foundry for everyone.
RINGMAKER.window.tokens.head: Tokens
RINGMAKER.window.tokens.done: Every matching token already has the ring.
RINGMAKER.window.tokens.hint: Apply turns the ring on (and moves tokens still at an art size Ringmaker set earlier to the current setting) for the prototype tokens of matching actors and every matching token on every scene. Remove puts back what each token had before and deletes Ringmaker's flags on it (recorded values, pop-out, art framing). Token art and portraits are never changed.
RINGMAKER.window.debug.label: Debug logging
RINGMAKER.window.debug.hint: Write what Ringmaker is doing to the browser console. Same world setting as in the module settings; errors are always logged.
RINGMAKER.window.dialog.apply.hint: Only the ring settings change; token images and portraits stay as they are. Remove Ringmaker's ring undoes it.
RINGMAKER.window.dialog.remove.body: Put every token and prototype token Ringmaker ringed back the way it was, and delete Ringmaker's data on them (the recorded ring values, the pop-out choice and the art framing)?
RINGMAKER.window.dialog.remove.hint: Tokens whose ring you turned on yourself keep their ring.
RINGMAKER.window.notice.allDone: Ringmaker: every matching token already has the ring.
RINGMAKER.window.notice.nothingToRemove: Ringmaker: no token or prototype token has Ringmaker's ring or data.
RINGMAKER.window.notice.placeReset: Ringmaker: the window will open at its default position next time.
RINGMAKER.tokenConfig.popOut.label: Art breaks out of ring
RINGMAKER.tokenConfig.popOut.hint: Ringmaker: token art outside the ring's opening is drawn over the ring instead of trimmed, so cut-out art can reach past the ring. Art inside the opening stays under the ring. Keep the art's own disc inside the opening (about two thirds of the image's width).
RINGMAKER.tokenConfig.artFraming.label: Art framing
RINGMAKER.tokenConfig.artFraming.fitLabe: Fit art to the ring's opening
RINGMAKER.tokenConfig.artFraming.fitTitl: Measure the image's opaque part and set the zoom so it fills the ring's opening
RINGMAKER.tokenConfig.artFraming.hint: Ringmaker: how the art sits inside the ring. Zoom 1 is Foundry's framing (below 1 shows more of the image, above 1 zooms in). Focus is the point of the image (0–1 from the top left) drawn at the ring's centre: put it on the face. Fit sets the zoom so cut-out art just fills the opening. Zoom 1 with focus 0.5/0.5 is the default.
RINGMAKER.notice.gmOnly: Ringmaker: only a GM can change tokens.
RINGMAKER.notice.activeGmOnly: Ringmaker: only the active GM can change tokens.
RINGMAKER.notice.noImage: Ringmaker: choose a ring image in the module settings first.
RINGMAKER.notice.removeConfirm: Put {what} back the way they were and delete Ringmaker's data on them?
